summary: WeRide Inc. (NYSE:WRD; HKEX:0800) filed a Form 6-K attaching its Next Day Disclosure Return for changes in issued shares. On May 6, 2026, it repurchased 473,133 ordinary shares at USD 2.4935 per share (total ~USD 1.18M) on Nasdaq, which are held as treasury shares, reducing issued shares to 949,491,869 while treasury shares increased to 23,016,172. The repurchase was authorized by the board and complies with HKEX listing rules. No premium, special tender, or cancellation was disclosed. Watch for ongoing buyback activity and potential impact on share float and EPS accretion.
